guitar.notes: Joe Walsh is well known for his black Les Paul Custom and use of talk box; well documented gear from Eagles/James Gang/solo career.

tone.target: nasal slide rock crunch with phaser swirl
tone.profile: nasal slide rock crunch with phaser swirl
tone.summary: A classic rock setup using a British amp model (UK 45) for mid-range bite, paired with an OD pedal and a Phaser effect to achieve the nasal slide rock sound.

rig.name: Joe Walsh - Rocky Mountain Way - Valeton GP-180

blocks.purpose: Clean up background noise and hum.
Provide mid-forward crunch and bite for the slide guitar texture.
blocks.gap: The Green OD is chosen over Blues OD/OD 9 to better emulate a slightly nasal, vintage tube grit without excessive dirt.

blocks.purpose: No dedicated distortion needed; the Green OD provides sufficient mid-range crunch.
blocks.gap: The required sound is 'crunch' rather than heavy saturation, making a dedicated DST module unnecessary and potentially muddying the tone.

blocks.purpose: Create the required 'phaser swirl' and modulation effect.
Emulate the Marshall-style amp and provide mid-forward character.
blocks.gap: The UK 45 is ideal for classic rock bite, matching the 'Marshall-style' clue better than US models.

blocks.purpose: Provide the required classic British cabinet tone and 4x12 voicing.
Boost the mid-frequencies to ensure a 'mid-forward crunch' and cut through the mix.
blocks.gap: Used to manually sculpt the tone for maximum bite, compensating for potential EQ gaps in the amp model.

blocks.purpose: Add subtle open sustain and natural room ambience without sounding overly ambient.
blocks.gap: A light Room reverb is used to enhance the 'open sustain' requirement without triggering the 'ambient delay' avoidance rule.

improvements.summary: Improve cabinet realism for better vintage bite.

proposals.reason: Enhance the classic Marshall-style bite and vintage character.
